description: Read exact source-time transcript words in bounded utterance pages. Word start/end values are seconds from the source media start. Default limit is 20; pass pagination.nextCursor as after for later pages. The formatter omits the unbounded fullText duplicate.

after.description: Zero-based utterance cursor returned as pagination.nextCursor.

before.description: Zero-based utterance cursor for a backward page. Do not combine with after.

name: get_transcript
title: Get Transcript
